steps.title: Coat plates with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Coat each 6‑well (or 12‑well) tissue‑culture plate with Matrigel and incubate for at least 01:00:00 before any passaging or harvesting steps.

steps.title: Warm reagents to room temperature
steps.instruction: Place ReLeSR, DMEM/F12, and mTesR1 (plus ROCK inhibitor if used) at room temperature until fully warmed.

steps.title: Wash iPSC cultures with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of PBS to each well of the confluent iPSC culture and gently aspirate.

steps.title: Add ReLeSR and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of ReLeSR to each well, then incubate at room temperature for 00:01:00–00:01:30.

steps.title: Aspirate ReLeSR and let detach
steps.instruction: Aspirate the ReLeSR with a p1000 pipette and leave the cells undisturbed for 00:05:00–00:07:00; aggregates will begin to lift from the well bottom after ~4.5 min.

steps.title: Add mTesR1 with ROCK inhibitor and collect aggregates
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of mTesR1 containing 5–10 µM ROCK inhibitor to each well, gently trickle down the wall, tap the plate to release aggregates, then transfer the entire 1 mL aggregate suspension from each well into a 15 mL conical tube using a p1000 (avoid pipetting up‑and‑down).

steps.title: Count aggregates and determine plating density
steps.instruction: Perform triplicate counts: pipette 100 µL of mTesR1 into three wells of a 96‑well flat‑bottom plate, add 5 µL of the aggregate suspension to each well, count aggregates sized 50–200 µm (ignore <100 µm), calculate the average per well, divide by the 5‑fold dilution to obtain aggregates / µL, and plan to plate 40–60 aggregates per well of a 6‑ or 12‑well plate (≈10 aggregates / cm²).

steps.title: Prepare Medium A and Medium B
steps.instruction: Add Supplement A to Hematopoietic Basal Medium at a 1:200 ratio to make Medium A, and add Supplement B at 1:200 to make Medium B. Store each at 4 °C for up to three days or freeze as 50 mL aliquots at –20 °C.

steps.title: Plate aggregates onto Matrigel‑coated wells
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of mTesR1 + desired ROCK inhibitor concentration to each Matrigel‑coated well, distribute the aggregate suspension evenly by moving the plate in quick, short, back‑and‑forth motions, then place the plate in a 37 °C, 6 % CO₂ incubator. Do not disturb for 24 h; aggregates usually attach within ~6 h.

steps.title: Verify colony attachment after 24 h
steps.instruction: After 24 h, count colonies: expect 20–38 colonies per well in a 6‑well plate (or 16–40 in a 12‑well plate). Aspirate medium, wash with PBS, and replace with fresh mTeSR™1. Do not proceed if >40 colonies per well are observed.

steps.title: Scheduled media changes (Days 0‑10)
steps.instruction:
Follow the timeline for a 6‑well plate:
- Day 0 (24 h after plating): aspirate medium, add 2 mL Medium A per well, incubate 37 °C/6 % CO₂.
- Day 2: gently add 1 mL Medium A per well.
- Day 3: aspirate Medium A, add 2 mL Medium B per well.
- Day 5: gently add 1 mL Medium B per well.
- Day 7: gently add 1 mL Medium B per well (floating cells become visible).
- Day 10: gently add 1 mL Medium B per well; optional harvest. Between Days 7‑10, add an extra 1 mL Medium B if the medium turns orange‑yellowish.

steps.title: Harvest floating cells for FACS (Day 12)
steps.instruction: Using a serological pipette or 1 mL micropipette, vigorously pipette the medium up‑and‑down 2–3 times in each well to break up floating aggregates, transfer the suspension to a conical tube, then wash the well with 1 mL DMEM/F12, triturate, and transfer; repeat the wash once more.

steps.title: Harvest adherent cells for FACS (Day 12)
steps.instruction: Wash each well with 1 mL D‑PBS and discard. Incubate the well at 37 °C for 00:20:00, then add 2 mL DMEM/F12 to the well, triturate vigorously with a 1 mL pipette tip to obtain a single‑cell suspension (do not scrape colonies). Wash the well with an additional 1 mL DMEM/F12 and add this wash to the same tube. Repeat the wash once.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells in FACS buffer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the combined floating‑and‑adherent cell suspension at 300 × g for 00:05:00 at room temperature. Resuspend the pellet in 300 µL sterile FACS Buffer (PBS + 2 % FBS) on ice (adjust volume if pellet is unusually small or large). Filter the suspension through a 40 µm filter into a new tube.

steps.title: Stain cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Add the following antibodies to the filtered cell suspension at 1:200 dilution each: CD34‑FITC, CD43‑APC, CD45‑Alexa Fluor 700, and optionally CD41‑PE. Incubate (time not specified).

steps.title: Wash stained cells and prepare for sorting
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of FACS Buffer to each tube, centrifuge at 300 × g for 00:05:00, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 500 µL FACS Buffer.

steps.title: Sort CD34⁺ CD43⁺ CD45⁺ population
steps.instruction: Using a BD FACSAria II, sort the triple‑positive (CD34⁺ CD43⁺ CD45⁺) cells into sterile collection tubes under sterile conditions. If proceeding directly to iMGL differentiation, resuspend the sorted cells in iMGL Diff Complete Medium at ~200,000–300,000 cells per well of a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Cryopreserve sorted cells (optional)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sorted cells at 300 × g for 00:10:00 at 4 °C, resuspend in Cryostor CS10 at 1 × 10⁶ cells per 1 mL, aliquot 1 mL per cryovial, place at –80 °C for ~24 h, then transfer to liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Thaw cryopreserved cells for iMGL differentiation
steps.instruction: Quickly thaw a cryovial in a 37 °C water bath (<1 min), transfer its contents to a conical tube containing 8 mL DMEM/F12 + 5 % FBS, centrifuge at 300 × g for 00:05:00, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in iMGL Diff Complete Medium at ~500,000 cells per well of a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Prepare iMGL differentiation complete medium
steps.instruction: To Hematopoietic Basal Medium add cytokines at 1:2000–1:5000 dilutions to achieve final concentrations of IL‑34 100 ng/mL (stock 500 µg/mL, 1:5000), TGF‑β1 50 ng/mL (stock 100 µg/mL, 1:2000), and M‑CSF 25 ng/mL (stock 100 µg/mL, 1:4000). Aliquot cytokine stocks at –80 °C; add fresh cytokines to basal medium on the day of use. Store remaining basal medium at 4 °C and use before depletion.

steps.title: Add iMGL medium on scheduled days
steps.instruction:
For a 6‑well plate add 1 mL per well of IMGL Diff Complete Medium as follows:
- Day 2, 4, 8, 10, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24: add 1 mL with 1X cytokine concentration.
- Day 6 and Day 12: split cultures (see next step) and add 1 mL with 2X cytokine concentration.
- Day 24: handle with care as plates may be nearly full.
If cells appear stressed at any point (e.g., after thawing or centrifugation), feed with 2X cytokine medium instead of 1X.

steps.title: Split cultures on designated days
steps.instruction: On Day 6 and Day 12 (and any later split), gently dissociate cells, redistribute to achieve the same total volume, and add 1 mL of IMGL Diff Complete Medium containing 2X cytokine concentration per well.

steps.title: Initiate maturation feeding after Day 37
steps.instruction: Prepare IMGL Maturation Medium by adding CD200 100 ng/mL (stock 100 µg/mL, 1:1000) and CX3CL1 100 ng/mL (stock 100 µg/mL, 1:1000) to the differentiation basal medium. Every 2 days feed each well with 1 mL of Maturation Medium plus 1X maintenance cytokines and 1X maturation cytokines; if cells look stressed, use 2X maintenance cytokines + 1X maturation cytokines.

steps.title: Split and expand iMGLs after Day 37
steps.instruction: Pre‑coat new plates with Matrigel for ≥01:00:00. Add 1 mL Accutase to each well, incubate as needed, then collect all but 1 mL of media from each well into a 50 mL conical tube and centrifuge at 300 × g for 00:06:00 at room temperature. While spinning, split 3 existing wells (N) into 1 new well (N′) by transferring ~300 µL from each of the 3 wells into the new Matrigel‑coated well. After spin, discard supernatant (reserve ~500 µL for future ELISA), resuspend the combined cell pellet in (N+N′) mL of iMGL differentiation complete medium containing 2X cytokines, and distribute 1 mL per well to all N+N′ wells.

steps.title: Confirm microglia maturity
steps.instruction: By Day 28, cells should display mature microglia‑like morphology and can be used experimentally for up to 2–3 weeks.
